{{Quote|How could this happen? Last month, I was president of the Makeb Mining Concern. Today, I'm&hellip; I don't know what I am.|The Concern's president|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
The '''Makeb Mining Concern''' was a business that conducted mining on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] before the [[Galactic War]] and the [[Conquest of Makeb|invasion]] of Makeb by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. The [[President of the Makeb Mining Concern|president]] of the Concern was one of many Makeb residents who were dislocated due to the invasion.
